desc:
🎉 Some Soccer Cards Are Rarer Than Others! 💸

HOW TO TRADE
Stand on a trading board with another player.
Both players add the cards they want to trade.
Both players step onto the ✅ button to confirm the trade.
Step onto the ❌ button to cancel the trade.
Step onto the ➕ button to ask for more cards.

Good luck collecting the rarest Soccer Cards! ⚽🏆
